title: Paul’s Letter From Lock-Up
paragraphs: §Joy in Chains

What's up, Philippi crew! It's Paul and Tim, just a couple of guys on Jesus's squad, hitting you up. This is for all the Jesus followers in town, including the head honchos and the whole team. We're sending you major positive energy and peace from God the Father and our main man, Jesus.

Every time I even *think* about you guys, I'm like, 'Thank you, God!' Seriously, every single time, it makes me want to pray for you, and I'm not even mad about it. I'm so stoked that you've been all-in with us, spreading the good news about Jesus since day one. I'm 100% sure that God, who started this awesome thing in you, is gonna see it through and give you a miraculous transformation on the day Jesus comes back.

And for real, I'm not just gassing you up. You guys are my ride-or-dies. You stuck with me when I was in jail, when I was on trial, and when I got out. You've been there for the whole crazy ride, and God's been super generous to us through it all. He knows I miss you guys like crazy. Sometimes I feel like I'm on the same wavelength as Jesus about you.

So, here's what I'm praying for you: that your love for each other just keeps leveling up. And not just that you love a lot, but that you love *smart*. You gotta use your brain and check your feelings so your love is the real deal, not just some mushy, fake stuff. Live like you're in love, a life that makes Jesus proud. A life that's producing all kinds of good stuff, making Jesus look good to everyone and getting them all in on praising God.

Hey, so I gotta tell you, being in jail has had the total opposite effect of what my haters wanted. Instead of shutting me down, the message about Jesus has blown up! All the guards here, and pretty much everyone else, found out I'm locked up because of Jesus. That made them curious, and now they're learning all about him. And get this: most of the other Jesus followers here are way more confident than ever, and they're not afraid to talk about God and Jesus.

Now, it's true that some people are preaching about Jesus just because they see me out of the way and they want the spotlight. But others are doing it for the right reasons. One group is all about love; they know I'm here defending the message and they want to help. The other group is just being greedy, trying to get something for themselves now that I'm not around. Their motives are wrong. They see me as competition, so they think the worse it is for me, the better it is for them.

So what do I do? I've decided I don't really care what their motives are. Whether they're good, bad, or whatever, every time they open their mouths, they're talking about Jesus, so I'm just gonna cheer them on!

And I'm gonna keep on cheering, because I know how this is all gonna end. With your prayers and the help of Jesus's Spirit, everything he wants to do in me and through me is gonna get done. I can't wait to see what's next. I'm not worried about being embarrassed at all. In fact, everything that's happening to me in here is just making Jesus more famous, whether I live or die. They didn't shut me up; they gave me a bigger stage! If I'm alive, I'm Jesus's messenger; if I'm dead, I'm his prize. It's a win-win. I can't lose.

As long as I'm alive, I've got good work to do. If I had to choose right now, I don't know what I'd pick. It's a tough call! The thought of leaving this life and being with Jesus is awesome. Some days, that's all I want. But most days, because of what you guys are going through, I know it's better for me to stick around. So, I'm planning on being here for a while, to help you grow and be joyful in your faith. You can look forward to a big reunion when I come visit you again. We'll be praising Jesus and having a great time together.

In the meantime, live in a way that makes the message of Jesus look good. Don't let your actions depend on whether I'm there or not. You've got to be the same whether I'm there to see it myself or I hear about it from far away. Stand together, have one goal, and fight for people to trust in the good news. Don't back down or get scared by the opposition. Your courage and unity will show them that they're going to lose and you're going to win—and it's all because of God. There's more to this life than just trusting in Jesus. There's also suffering for him. And the suffering is just as much a gift as the trust. You're in the same fight you saw me go through, and you're getting an update on it in this letter.

title: How to Be a Real MVP
paragraphs: §Think Like Jesus

So, if you've gotten anything good out of following Jesus, if His love has actually changed you, if being part of our squad means anything, and if you guys have any heart at all—do me a solid. Get on the same page, love each other, and be true ride-or-die friends. Don't be that person who's always trying to be the main character. Don't try to sweet-talk your way to the top. Instead, be humble and hype up your friends. Don't just look out for number one. Forget about yourself for a minute and help someone else out.

Your attitude should be the same as Jesus'. He was literally on the same level as God, but He didn't flex His power. He didn't cling to His top-tier status. Nah, when the time was right, He gave up all His perks, and basically became a servant. He became human! And He stayed human, which was a total glow-down for Him. He didn't ask for special treatment. He just lived a humble, obedient life and then died a humble, obedient death—the worst kind of death, too: crucifixion.
§God Lifted Him Up

Because He was so obedient, God gave Him the ultimate transformation and honored Him more than anyone or anything, ever. So now, everyone in heaven, on earth, and even the ghosts of people long gone, will bow down and worship Jesus. They'll all shout out that He's the boss, bringing major props to God the Father.

So, my friends, here's the deal. Just keep doing what you've been doing. When I was with you, you were all about listening and obeying. Now that I'm gone, you gotta step it up even more. Go hard in your faith, and be respectful and aware of God. That power you feel? That's God's power inside you, helping you do what makes Him happy.

Do everything without complaining or second-guessing. Go out there and be a breath of fresh air in this messed-up world. Show people what it's like to live a good life and know the living God. Be the light in the darkness, so when Jesus comes back, I can be proud of you. You'll be the proof that all my hard work wasn't for nothing.
And even if I get taken out right here, right now, I'll be happy to be part of the sacrifice of your faith. But hey, you gotta be happy for me too. Whatever you do, don't feel bad for me.

I'm planning to send Timothy to you guys soon, so he can give me the scoop on how you're all doing. That would be awesome. There's no one else like Timothy. He's a real one, and he actually cares about you. Most people are just in it for themselves and don't really care about Jesus' mission. But you know Timothy is legit. He's been like a son to me, and we've been spreading the message together. As soon as I know what's up with my situation here, I'll send him your way. And I'm hoping I'll be right behind him.

But for now, I'm sending Epaphroditus back to you. He's my boy, my partner in crime. You sent him to help me, and now I'm sending him to help you. He's been dying to see you all, especially since you heard he was sick. He wanted to let you know he's all good now. He almost died, for real, but God showed him mercy. And not just him, but me too. If he had died, it would have been another huge L for me.

So you see why I'm so stoked to send him back. When you see him all healthy and strong, you'll be so happy, and I'll be relieved. Give him a huge welcome and a big hug. People like him deserve all the respect. Remember how you guys started helping me but couldn't finish? Well, he finished the job, and he almost died doing it. What a legend.

title: All-In for the Win
paragraphs: §Knowing Christ Is Everything

Alright, guys, let's wrap this up. The main thing is to be stoked about God! I know I sound like a broken record, but it's super important, so I'm gonna say it again: watch out for the haters. I'm talking about those super-religious show-offs who are all talk. They're obsessed with outward stuff, like old-school rituals, but they're missing the point. We're the real deal because we're powered by God's Spirit, and we're all about hyping up Christ. We know we can't do this on our own, even though my resume is pretty stacked. Seriously, I was born into the right family, part of the tribe of Benjamin, a rule-following expert, and I was so hardcore I even went after the church. I was basically a straight-A student in the rulebook.

But all that stuff I used to flex about? It's garbage. I've tossed it all out. Why? Because knowing Jesus is the ultimate prize. Everything else is just trash compared to the epic privilege of knowing him personally. I've dumped my old achievements so I can fully grab onto Christ and have him grab onto me. I don't want some weak, rule-based 'goodness.' I want the real, powerful kind that comes from trusting Christ—the kind that's straight from God.

I ditched all that lame stuff so I could really know Christ, feel his resurrection power, and even be part of his crew through the tough times, right up to the end. If there's a way to be in on the ultimate comeback—the resurrection—I'm all in.

Look, I'm not saying I'm perfect or that I've got it all figured out. But I'm on the journey, chasing after Christ, who amazingly chased after me first. Don't get it twisted, I'm no expert. But I'm laser-focused on the finish line, where God is calling us to be with Jesus. I'm running my race, and I'm not looking back.
So, for those of us who are serious about this, let's stay locked in on that goal. If you're getting sidetracked, God will get you back on track. We're on the right path, so let's keep moving.

Stick with me on this, and watch the people who are running the same race. There are a lot of people out there on different paths, chasing other things, and they'll try to get you to follow them. I've warned you about them before, and I'm saying it again: they're all about taking the easy way out. They can't stand the cross. But that easy street is a dead end. They're all about their own desires, and their life is just about feeding their own appetites.

But our story is way different. We're citizens of heaven! We're waiting for our Savior, the boss, Jesus Christ. He's going to give our regular bodies a miraculous transformation, making them awesome like his. He's got the power to put everything in its right place, and he's gonna make us whole.

title: The No-Stress Guide to Life
paragraphs: §Rejoice Always

Alright, listen up, my crew. You guys are the best, seriously. I'm so proud of you, so just keep doing what you're doing and stay solid with God. And hey, Euodia and Syntyche, you two need to squash your beef and make up. It's not a good look. My man Syzygus, I need you to be the ref and help them sort it out. These ladies were total rockstars for the cause, right there with me and the rest of the OG squad. Their names are in God's Book of Life, so they need to act like it.

Keep the positive energy going with God 24/7. Seriously, get hyped about him! And be cool with everyone you meet; let them know you're on their team. The Boss could show up any second, so be ready! Don't stress or worry about anything. Instead of panicking, just pray. Turn your worries into a conversation with God, and let him know what's up. Before you know it, you'll feel this awesome sense of peace, like everything's gonna be alright. It's a total game-changer when you let God's peace take over instead of letting worry run your life.
§Think About These Things

To wrap it up, my friends, you've gotta guard your thoughts. Focus on stuff that's real, honorable, right, pure, and awesome. Think about the best things, not the worst; the transformations, not the fails. Basically, whatever is worth praising, lock your mind on that. Just copy what you learned from me—the stuff you heard me say and saw me do. If you do that, the God who lines everything up perfectly will bring some of that perfect harmony into your life.

I was so stoked to see you guys showing you care about me again. Not that you ever stopped, you just didn't have a chance to show it. But for real, it's not like I *needed* anything. I've learned the secret to being happy no matter what's going on. I'm good with a little and I'm good with a lot. I can handle being totally full or starving, having tons of cash or being broke. I can power through literally anything because of the One who gives me strength. But don't get me wrong, your help was a huge deal. It was awesome that you had my back when I was in a tight spot.

You guys in Philippi know the deal. When I first hit the road with the Message, you were the only church that had my back, the only ones who supported me. You even sent help more than once when I was in Thessalonica. I'm not saying this because I'm looking for a handout. I just want you to get the rewards that come from being generous.

And now, I'm totally set. The stuff you sent with Epaphroditus was more than enough. It was like the best-smelling BBQ on the grill for God—he loved it. And you can bet that same God will take care of everything you need. His generosity is way bigger than yours, and it all comes through Jesus. Our God and Father gets all the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Say hi to all of God's people for me. My friends here say what's up. All the Christians here, especially the crew who work in Caesar's palace—the government headquarters—send their greetings.
May the incredible grace of our leader, Jesus Christ, be with you all, deep down in your spirit.
